winter_limits: First-come only (no reservations) in winter, $20 a night electric ($40 for the double electric site) vs $34 in peak. 14-night maximum in any 30 days. Winter water, bathhouse and dump status not published; the posted gatehouse hours cover only April-October.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: Loop B sites 78-103 (25 electric) are open first-come, first-served Nov 9 - Mar 14 at the winter rate; all other loops are closed until April 1.
sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-14, STANDARD ELECTRIC $20; 'Peak Season' 2027-04-01 to 2027-10-31; next winter season 2027-11-15 to 2027-12-31); recreation.gov calendar 233563 Nov 2026-Mar 2027 (B 078-103 'Not Reservable' every night 2026-11-09 to 2027-03-14, all other 207 sites 'Closed'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563 (gatehouse hours notice covers April-October only); read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: That the 25 'Not Reservable' Loop B sites are the walk-up sites is inferred from the rate table's 'First-come, First-served Season' matching their dates exactly; no notice names the loop. Mar 15-31 and Nov 1-8 carry no calendar data (likely closed between seasons). The winter-season start date shifts yearly (2024-11-01, 2026-11-09, 2027-11-15), so no fixed recurring season is given. Aggregators (outdoorithm, The Dyrt) say Nov 15-Mar 31 with heated bathhouses - leads only. USACE district page answered 403, not read.
